selected_dialogue.speaker: LADY JULIANA
selected_dialogue.text: Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest.

selected_dialogue.speaker: PRUDENCE
selected_dialogue.text: Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!

selected_dialogue.speaker: LADY JULIANA
selected_dialogue.text: Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning.

selected_dialogue.speaker: PRUDENCE
selected_dialogue.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

selected_dialogue.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.

selected_dialogue.text: I'll take that wager over your decree.

selected_dialogue.speaker: ALEXANDER
